subject: Alliant connector outage: escalation & partner on-call ownership transfer
messages:
From: Devon Park <devon@alliant.systems>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Alliant connector failures after token refresh - urgent

Hi Naomi / Marissa,

We started seeing spikes of 502/timeout errors for our integration with Redwood starting ~08:50 PT after our scheduled token refresh. The error rate is ~35% for inbound webhooks and several retry loops are building up on our side.

Quick context: we rotate short-lived client tokens every 24h as part of our infra policy; this morning’s refresh should have been transparent. We do see failures that coincide with token refresh windows (attached partial logs).

Impact:
- Production customer webhooks delayed, some customers reporting repeated duplicate deliveries.
- Increased CPU on our workers from retries.

Can we escalate to on-call and get an immediate short-term mitigation? Specifically:
- Is there a way Redwood can temporarily accept the previous token for a 30-60m window while we validate the new one?
- If not, can we route traffic to a regional fallback to limit impact?

I attached the error snippet and a HAR for initial debugging. We’ll be available on this thread and will give contact for our on-call if handoff is required after 18:00 PT.

Attachments: alliant-error-log-20270618.txt, partner-har.zip (referenced)

Thanks,
Devon Park
Integration Lead, Alliant Systems
devon@alliant.systems
+1 415-555-0187

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Devon Park <devon@alliant.systems>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Alliant connector failures after token refresh - urgent

Devon — thanks for the quick heads up and the logs. We’re investigating right away.

Immediate actions we can take now:
- Enable regional fallback (route to us-west read-only pool) to reduce 502s while we triage — I can flip this within 10 mins.
- We can accept the previous token for a short window as an emergency rollback, but we need confirmation from you that the old token is not actively compromised. If you confirm, we’ll allow a 45-minute acceptance window and log all matches.

Requests from our side to help debug quickly:
- Full HAR (the partial one helped) and a timestamped list of failing request IDs.
- Confirm the name/email/phone for your on-call after-hours contact (if you want ownership transferred to Alliant on-call after 18:00 PT).

Operational note: Marissa will coordinate the SLA/ownership transfer paperwork if we hand off on-call to Alliant overnight. Ben, can you prepare a minimal runbook with the exact steps to roll token acceptance back and re-enable strict validation? Link a short runbook here so both teams have parity: https://drive.google.com/open?id=runbook-alliance-20270618

I’ll enable fallback now and post a follow-up when done.

- Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Partner Reliability Lead, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: proposed ownership & escalation steps (Alliant)

Internal note — moving this into the thread so we have a single audit trail. Proposed plan:

1) Immediate mitigation (Redwood) — Jonas/Ben
   - Flip regional fallback (Ben) — reduces error surface for Alliant customers.
   - If token rollback is approved by Alliant, apply temporary acceptance and monitor for anomalies (Jonas).

2) After-hours ownership (requested) — hand to Alliant on-call from 18:00–08:00 PT:
   - Redwood will keep the fallback and monitoring active.
   - Alliant on-call will own triage and initial customer comms; Redwood on-call will be escalation-only (P2/P1).

3) SLA alignment & runbook:
   - Ben to publish a 5-step runbook to the shared Drive and link the Jira INT-889.
   - Marissa to draft the short amendment to the partner SLA covering token rotation windows and emergency rollbacks.

4) Post-mortem: 1-week follow-up working session and a joint RCA doc.

Ben — can you have the runbook up in the Drive in the next 45 minutes? Jonas — please stand by to take the temporary token acceptance toggle if Devon confirms.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head, Partner Programs, Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@alliant.systems>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Devon Park <devon@alliant.systems>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 11:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Alliant connector failures after token refresh - urgent

On Fri, Jun 18, 2027 at 9:45 AM Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com> wrote:
> Devon — thanks for the quick heads up and the logs. We’re investigating right away.
> 
> Immediate actions we can take now:
> - Enable regional fallback (route to us-west read-only pool) to reduce 502s while we triage — I can flip this within 10 mins.
> - We can accept the previous token for a short window as an emergency rollback, but we need confirmation from you that the old token is not actively compromised. If you confirm, we’ll allow a 45-minute acceptance window and log all matches.

Thanks Naomi — we confirm the old token is not compromised; it was rotated as part of a scheduled job that completed successfully but some services re-sent old tokens during the window.

Our after-hours on-call for tonight:
- Sarah Cho (primary) — +1 206-555-0123, sarah.cho@alliant.systems (starts 18:00 PT)
- Devon Park (backup) — devon@alliant.systems

We appreciate Redwood enabling fallback. We’re attaching a fuller HAR and the request IDs you asked for (see attached). We accept on-call ownership for the 18:00–08:00 PT window, provided Redwood keeps the regional fallback and logging enabled so we can correlate.

Attachments: alliant-error-log-20270618.txt, redwood-debug-har-20270618.zip

—Sarah
Sarah Cho
SRE Lead, Alliant Systems

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@alliant.systems>, Devon Park <devon@alliant.systems>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Alliant connector failures after token refresh - urgent

Thanks Sarah — confirming the plan and timeline:

- Redwood has enabled the regional fallback at 09:52 PT and rolled the temporary token acceptance window from 09:55–10:40 PT to allow you to complete reconciliation. We observed ~12% error reduction after the fallback — monitoring continues.
- Per your request, Redwood will keep the fallback and the extended token acceptance logs on for the overnight window (18:00–08:00 PT). We will be escalation-only for P1/P0 issues; Alliant on-call will own initial triage and customer communications.
- Ben has published the 5-step runbook here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=runbook-alliance-20270618 and I’ve created INT-889 for any code changes and tracking: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INT-889
- Marissa will circulate a 1-paragraph SLA amendment for you to sign off; expected in the next 24h.

Next steps:
- Alliant on-call (Sarah) to acknowledge at 18:00 PT on this thread when you take ownership.
- Joint RCA working session proposed: Mon 2027-06-21 10:00 PT (Marissa to send invite).

Appreciate the fast coordination — I’ll keep monitoring and will escalate immediately if we see further regression.

Naomi Feldman
Partner Reliability Lead, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com
+1 650-555-0199
